description: Capability for Lare Terminal Markdown output windows (ADR-013). Grants core:default so window.js can invoke take_window_content and close_self via Tauri IPC. Grants core:window:allow-start-dragging to enable the data-tauri-drag-region titlebar on the chromeless, transparent window. Scoped to md-* labels (all runtime Markdown windows). Global-shortcut permissions are intentionally NOT included here — they are only needed by the main overlay window.
